professionalSummary.text: Senior frontend engineer with proven experience building and maintaining complex scheduling interfaces in Vue, delivering measurable reductions in client‑side error rates and ensuring robust test coverage.
professionalSummary.witness: Built and looked after the dock-schedule board and shift planner in the warehouse scheduling app (Vue): the drag-and-drop slot editor, the overlap highlighting for shifts and the printable day view planners asked for.

experienceHighlights.text: Led end‑to‑end maintenance of the dock‑schedule board and shift planner, including drag‑and‑drop slot editing, shift overlap highlighting, and printable day‑view planners.
experienceHighlights.witness: Built and looked after the dock-schedule board and shift planner in the warehouse scheduling app (Vue): the drag-and-drop slot editor, the overlap highlighting for shifts and the printable day view planners asked for.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed Vitest component tests and Playwright browser tests, adding a board‑render smoke test that must pass before release.
experienceHighlights.witness: Looked after the Vitest component tests and the Playwright browser tests; a board-render smoke test I added now has to pass before a release can go out.

experienceHighlights.text: Reduced client‑side error rate from 4.1 to 0.9 errors per thousand sessions within two months of a state‑management rewrite, meeting the published baseline.
experienceHighlights.witness: The schedule board's client-side error rate fell from 4.1 errors per thousand sessions to 0.9 after the state-management rewrite, measured by the application's error monitoring over the following two months against the published baseline of 4.1.

experienceHighlights.text: Co‑ordinated API changes with backend team, ensuring alignment with approved endpoints and maintaining change records.
experienceHighlights.witness: Took API changes through the backend team's review, where the backend lead had the final say on endpoints; my side was adapting the board and planner to whatever was approved.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored release write‑ups and on‑call hand‑over documentation, detailing limitations such as multi‑day slot handling and providing clear hand‑over sheets for frontend on‑call engineers.
experienceHighlights.witness: Kept the app's release write-ups, which recorded among other things that the slot editor could not yet handle multi-day slots, and the hand-over sheet the frontend on-call engineer reads.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided a twelve‑week export from the error monitoring tool with baseline and rewrite release markers, alongside Playwright smoke test results and pipeline run numbers for traceability.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: a twelve-week export from the error monitoring tool (weekly errors per thousand sessions, with the baseline and the rewrite release marked) plus the Playwright smoke test; pipeline run numbers are included so the entries can be traced.

skills.text: Vue.js, Vitest, Playwright, state‑management (Vuex/Pinia), error monitoring, API integration, test‑driven development, release documentation, on‑call hand‑over.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s direct experience with dock‑schedule board and shift planner development, test suite maintenance, error‑rate reduction, API coordination, and release documentation. They do not provide evidence of broader product ownership or cross‑team leadership beyond the stated responsibilities.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate demonstrates strong evidence for all technical requirements; human review recommended to assess fit and potential gaps.

evidence.text: Built and looked after the dock-schedule board and shift planner in the warehouse scheduling app (Vue): the drag-and-drop slot editor, the overlap highlighting for shifts and the printable day view planners asked for.
Looked after the Vitest component tests and the Playwright browser tests; a board-render smoke test I added now has to pass before a release can go out.
evidence.notes: Shows test suite maintenance and extension.

evidence.text: The schedule board's client-side error rate fell from 4.1 errors per thousand sessions to 0.9 after the state-management rewrite, measured by the application's error monitoring over the following two months against the published baseline of 4.1.

Work sample: a twelve-week export from the error monitoring tool (weekly errors per thousand sessions, with the baseline and the rewrite release marked) plus the Playwright smoke test; pipeline run numbers are included so the entries can be traced.
Took API changes through the backend team's review, where the backend lead had the final say on endpoints; my side was adapting the board and planner to whatever was approved.
Kept the app's release write-ups, which recorded among other things that the slot editor could not yet handle multi-day slots, and the hand-over sheet the frontend on-call engineer reads.
